content:
Apple is continuing to roll out multiple release candidates for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and Sequoia 15.7.8, now releasing the fifth release candidate (RC 5) for both systems, while also pushing out the fifth round of developer betas for iOS 26.6, macOS 26.6, iPadOS 26.6, and more. Here's what you need to know.

macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and Sequoia 15.7.8 Fifth Release Candidates Now Available

Developers testing macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and Sequoia 15.7.8 can now install the fifth release candidates, along with the fifth betas of macOS 26.6 and related versions.

Today's release candidates carry the following build numbers: macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 is 23J615, and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 is 24G817.

Apple has not disclosed what these updates contain, providing only the standard release note: "This update includes important security fixes and is recommended for all users."

This release comes shortly after the rollout of iOS, iPadOS, and macOS 26.5.2. The 26.5.2 update included security fixes that Apple had originally planned to ship with 26.6, but pushed them out early due to risks posed by new AI-powered tools. As a result, some of the remaining fixes expected in 26.6 may already be included in this release.

For more information about Apple's security releases, please visit this link.
